Extract metadata returns document metadata when enabled

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import ConversionOptions, convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<html><head><title>Test Page</title><meta name='description' content='A test page'></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>"
    options = ConversionOptions(extract_metadata=True)
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)
    print(result.metadata.document.title)
    print(result.metadata.document.description)

main()
```
